description.ja: HGUCシリーズの“アッガイ”、“ズゴック”、“ゴッグ”をセットがリリース。アッガイは腕の伸縮をパーツの差し替えにより再現 ズゴックは自由度の高い関節により劇中さながらのアクションポーズが再現可能。ゴッグはパーツの差し替えにより、水中航行形態へ変形可能。セット専用のデカールが付属。
description.en: A set of “Aggai”, “Z’Gok” and “Gog” from the HGUC series has been released. Acguy's arm extension and contraction can be reproduced by replacing parts. Z'Gok's highly flexible joints allow him to recreate action poses just like in the movie. Gog can be transformed into an underwater navigation form by replacing parts. A set-specific decal is included.
